title: Client-management SaaS active student and session report
source_system: Client-management SaaS reports (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: 55 active student profiles: 36 in grades 2 to 7 (under 13) and 19 in grades 8 to 12; about 32 booked session hours a week in the spring term; about 60% of session hours online and the rest in students' homes or a library study room; every student is in Florida; each profile holds the student's name, grade and school, parent names, emails, phone numbers and home address, and session note summaries

title: Client-management SaaS invoice report, January to June 2026, and payment settings
source_system: Client-management SaaS reports and payment settings (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: About $3,500 billed a week during the school year (about $700 per weekday); most families prepay 10-session packages; card payments run through the payment processor's hosted page, and the account holds no full card numbers; every payer is a parent

title: Client-management SaaS account security and user settings
source_system: Client-management SaaS admin settings (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: One staff account, the owner's administrator account; the vendor enforces MFA on it, and the authenticator app on the owner's phone is the only registered second factor; each parent has a parent login that shows only that family's schedule and invoices; the vendor keeps a sign-in history

title: Enrollment agreement template and e-signature report
source_system: Client-management SaaS documents and e-signature records (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: An e-signed enrollment agreement is on file for every active student's family; the agreement covers tutoring and payment terms, states that family information is used to teach the child, mentions the practice portal for assignments in one line, and has a photo and recording permission checkbox; it does not list what the portal collects, how it is used, or who receives it, and does not describe the signature as the consent step for the portal; each portal account in EV-010 was created after the family's e-signature and first payment

title: Email and files suite account security, plan and sync settings
source_system: Email and files suite admin console (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Paid business plan with one licensed user, the owner, who is also the suite administrator; password sign-in, with MFA available on the plan and turned off; the vendor keeps a sign-in history; file version history is kept for 30 days (vendor default); desktop sync is on for the laptop and covers every student folder; no other backup service is connected

title: Student folder listing
source_system: Email and files suite file storage (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Folders for about 265 students: 55 current and about 210 former students, the oldest from 2019, none deleted; about 39 folders (9 current, about 30 former) hold IEP or Section 504 plans or psychoeducational evaluations shared by parents; other contents are assessments, progress notes, learning plans, photos of work and report cards; a spreadsheet in the business folder lists every student portal user name and password

title: File sharing report
source_system: Email and files suite admin console (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: 12 student folders are shared with parents through links that anyone with the link can open

title: Browser saved passwords and password checkup
source_system: Web browser on the laptop (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: Passwords for the business accounts are saved in the browser; the browser's password checkup flags two passwords reused across accounts; no password manager is installed

title: Website-builder administrator security settings and site history
source_system: Website-builder admin settings (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Administrator sign-in is password only; MFA is offered at no cost and turned off; the site history shows the student portal launched in January 2025 and reading-aloud audio uploads added to the portal in August 2025; the builder keeps a 90-day activity history

title: Student portal member list
source_system: Website-builder members area (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: 61 student member accounts, all enabled: 34 for current students and 27 for students who stopped tutoring; 2 of the 36 families with children under 13 have no member account; the owner set each member's password at account creation

title: Website and student portal page capture
source_system: Public website and portal pages (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: No children's privacy notice and no link to one on the home page, the portal sign-in page, the sign-up form or the upload pages; the members area is built for students in grades 2 to 7 and collects a child's first and last name, a user name, photos of work, reading-aloud audio clips and messages to the owner; the sign-up form requires the child's birth date and school name; each student sees only their own assignments, uploads and messages

title: Website-builder analytics settings and terms of service
source_system: Website-builder admin settings; builder website
what_it_shows: Site-wide visitor analytics is on and sets cookies on every page, including the members area; the owner's analytics dashboard shows page counts; the builder's standard terms say it may use analytics data to improve its services; no data processing addendum or written security commitment for member content is part of the accepted terms

title: Video platform account, recording settings and recording list
source_system: Video platform admin settings (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Paid plan; the owner's host account signs in with a password only, with MFA available and turned off; cloud recording is on; recordings are stored for 11 families, none deleted; the automatic recording deletion setting is off; the enrollment records (EV-004) show that 3 of these 11 families did not tick the recording permission checkbox; standard subscription terms, with no data processing addendum

title: Laptop settings review
source_system: Laptop settings screens (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: One user account, the owner's, signed in to every business service; family members use it for browsing, and the installed apps include games they added; full-disk encryption off; built-in antivirus on with real-time scanning and automatic updates; automatic operating system updates on and update history current; host firewall on; screen locks after 15 minutes idle; the email suite's desktop sync client syncs every student folder; the downloads folder holds student files; no backup app or external drive is set up; the IT technician's remote-support tool is installed

title: Mobile phone settings and content review
source_system: Mobile phone settings screens (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Passcode with biometric unlock; device encryption on; locks after 1 minute; automatic updates and built-in malware protection on; the camera roll holds photos of student work and syncs to the owner's personal photo cloud account; text threads with parents in the standard messaging app; the authenticator app holds the second factors for the client-management SaaS and the accounting SaaS

title: Home router settings and connected devices
source_system: Internet service provider's router admin page (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: The router admin password is the default printed on the router label; the router firewall is on and firmware updates install automatically; the connected device list shows the laptop on the same network as family phones and smart-home devices; a guest network is available and turned off

title: Accounting SaaS account security and data review
source_system: Accounting SaaS settings (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: MFA on, with the second factor on the owner's phone; records hold parent names and payment amounts only; a monthly import from the client-management SaaS; the annual accounting export goes to the tax preparer

title: AI assistant account settings and chat history
source_system: Consumer AI assistant, personal account (SYS-09)
what_it_shows: Free personal account with password sign-in; chat history on; the setting that lets the vendor use chats to improve its models is on; chats since March 2026 contain student first names, grades, assessment and portal assignment scores, and accommodations from IEP and 504 plans; they include support-level ratings for 31 students (spring term), SAT boot camp starting levels for 12 students (June 2026), and drafts of about 45 parent progress reports (May 2026)

title: AI assistant consumer terms of service
source_system: AI assistant vendor website
what_it_shows: Click-through consumer terms; the vendor may use prompts and chats to improve its models unless the user turns that setting off; no written security or deletion commitment for business data

title: Home office walk-through
source_system: Home office (observation)
what_it_shows: Paper worksheets and printed notes in a closed cabinet in the home office; a cross-cut shredder used for paper; the laptop replaced in 2024 is in a desk drawer and still holds student files; the business laptop sits open on the family room table between sessions and travels in the teaching bag to students' homes and the library

title: Signed agreements and vendor folder
source_system: Owner's agreements folder (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: On file: the IT technician's confidentiality and data-handling agreement (signed 2026-07-08); the client-management SaaS terms with a data processing addendum covering security, use limitation and deletion; the tax preparer's engagement letter; subscription terms for the email suite, video platform and accounting SaaS. Not located: a data processing addendum or written security assurance from the website builder, the video platform or the AI assistant vendor, and any record of a vendor review

title: Client-management SaaS SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Client-management SaaS vendor (provided on request)
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Availability categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31; unqualified opinion; one exception (2 of 25 sampled departing vendor employees kept access past the 1-day target), with remediation described by management; the system description states RTO 12 hours and RPO 1 hour; encryption at rest and in transit and backup controls tested; lists complementary user entity controls; the hosting provider and the payment processor are carved-out subservice organizations

title: Bank and card statements, 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
source_system: Business bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the email and files suite, the client-management SaaS, the website builder, the video platform and the accounting SaaS; hourly payments to the IT technician; an annual fee to the tax preparer; a general liability insurance premium; no payment to an AI vendor and no cyber insurance premium; deposits are card settlements from the client-management SaaS processor, with no payment from a school, district or government agency

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files (prepared by the tax preparer)
what_it_shows: Gross receipts of about $180,000; no wages paid; the business is a sole proprietorship with no employees

title: Search of the owner's files for security and privacy documents
source_system: Laptop; email and files suite; paper files
what_it_shows: No written information security program, policy, risk assessment, data retention policy or schedule, incident plan, contact list, children's privacy notice, vendor review, or security or children's privacy training record was found; no record of any review of a sign-in history

title: General liability policy declarations and insurance agent's email
source_system: Insurance agent portal; email inbox (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: General liability policy in force for 2026 with no cyber coverage listed; the agent's email of 2026-07-09 confirms the policy does not cover data breach costs; a cyber insurance quote was requested

title: Parent question about the portal and the owner's reply
source_system: Email inbox (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: One parent asked in 2025 what the portal keeps; the owner answered informally by email

title: Former web designer's final invoice and handover email
source_system: Email inbox (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Invoice for building the website and the student portal, with the handover email; no later invoice or engagement with the designer appears in the inbox

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: Owner-tutor's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT technician
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems and vendors used, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; the owner is the only person who performs each function and holds every account credential; there is no substitute tutor; sessions depend on home power and internet, with the phone hotspot as the fallback; the IT technician can lend a laptop within a day

title: Risk walk-through of devices, network and accounts
source_system: Walk-through of the laptop, phone, router and each SaaS account with the IT technician
what_it_shows: Where children's information ends up day to day (synced student folders, the laptop downloads folder, the phone camera roll and its photo cloud, parent text threads, session recordings, AI assistant chats, the 2024 laptop); the laptop travels to students' homes and the library, is often left open in the family room, and family members browse and install games under the owner's account; the phone hotspot or library Wi-Fi is used away from home; the portal password spreadsheet sits in the synced folders

title: COPPA and Florida self-review
source_system: Owner-tutor's written answers to the questions for 16 CFR 312.4 to 312.11 and the three Florida duties, checked on screen with the IT technician
what_it_shows: No message to families was sent when the audio feature was added in August 2025; the owner deletes portal content when a parent asks, but not session recordings, AI assistant chats or synced and downloaded copies, and keeps no record of requests; parents see portal content only by signing in with the child's user name and the password the owner set; the owner looks only at page counts in the analytics; no portal feature uses the birth date or school name; the builder's deletion of backups is not documented; the owner was never designated in writing as program coordinator; students are not told when a recording starts; the owner has had no security or children's privacy training; the business has not joined a COPPA safe harbor program

title: AI output check
source_system: AI assistant chat history; the owner's learning plans; the publisher's diagnostic rubric; session notes
what_it_shows: The learning plans keep 27 of the 31 AI support levels and all 12 boot camp placements as the assistant gave them; re-placing the 12 boot camp students with the publisher's diagnostic rubric gave a level one step different for 3; for 9 of the 31 support levels the owner could not tie the rating to the scores; 7 of 9 students with IEP or 504 plans were rated high support, against 8 of 22 without, at similar scores; 2 of 10 drafted progress reports checked against session notes had a wrong score, and the owner had caught 1 of them before sending

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: P01 risk register; P05 BIA; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment identifies 15 threat events with sources and vulnerabilities, rates likelihood and impact with Tables G-5 and I-2, includes harm to children, draws on the BIA, and is documented; results were shared with the IT technician; no review frequency or update trigger was defined at the time of assessment

title: Control assessment: Account management test
source_system: Website-builder member and collaborator lists; laptop user accounts; email suite sharing report; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The owner manages every account and creates portal accounts only after the parent e-signs and pays; the website builder listed the former web designer as a collaborator with edit rights over the site and the portal, and the owner removed the account during the test; the builder's 90-day activity history showed no sign-in by that account; 27 portal accounts of students who stopped tutoring were enabled; family members use the owner's laptop account; the owner held every portal password; no account review or sign-in review has taken place

title: Control assessment: Administrator MFA sign-in test
source_system: Administrator sign-ins to the email suite, website builder, video platform and client-management SaaS from a new browser
what_it_shows: Administrator sign-ins to the email suite, website builder and video platform succeeded with a password only; the client-management SaaS asked for the second factor on the phone

title: Control assessment: Mailbox and accounting MFA sign-in test
source_system: Mailbox and accounting SaaS sign-ins from a new browser
what_it_shows: The owner's mailbox signed in with a password only; the accounting SaaS required the second factor

title: Control assessment: Encryption status check
source_system: Laptop and phone encryption status screens; client-management SaaS SOC 2 report
what_it_shows: Laptop full-disk encryption off; phone encrypted; the client-management SaaS encrypts stored data (SOC 2 report)

title: Control assessment: Backup review and restore test
source_system: Email suite version history and sync settings; restore of one student folder; client-management SaaS SOC 2 report
what_it_shows: One student folder was restored from the email suite's version history in 25 minutes, witnessed by the IT technician; student folders and security documents exist only as the synced copy plus 30-day version history; the client-management SaaS vendor backs up the system and protects backup confidentiality, integrity and availability, with backups in a separate location (SOC 2 report, no exceptions in backup controls)

title: Control assessment: Vendor assurance review
source_system: Vendor terms and settings for SYS-01 to SYS-04, SYS-08 and SYS-09; client-management SaaS SOC 2 report and addendum; IT technician agreement; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The website builder, video platform and AI assistant hold children's information under standard or consumer terms with no written security assurances; the AI assistant's terms allow prompts to improve its models; no required vendor safeguards, vendor list or oversight steps are documented; only the client-management SaaS vendor is monitored (SOC 2 review on 2026-07-15); customer responsibilities for that vendor are listed in its SOC 2 report, and the IT technician's role in the signed agreement

title: Control assessment: Retention review
source_system: Student folders; portal member list; video recording list; phone camera roll; the 2024 laptop; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No retention policy exists; folders of about 210 former students since 2019, 27 inactive portal accounts and all recordings are kept; output copies (downloads, phone photos, the 2024 laptop) are kept with no schedule

title: Control assessment: Privacy notice review and walk-through
source_system: Website home page, portal sign-in and upload pages, and enrollment agreement; parent's-eye walk-through of the website and portal
what_it_shows: No children's privacy notice on the home page, the sign-in page or the upload pages, at first use or later; the enrollment agreement mentions the portal in one line among unrelated terms and does not state the purposes of collection or that processing rests on parental consent
